description:
Go on a jungle safari with the cutest animals!

Safari Friends is a big 8.5 x 11 coloring and activity book made for kids ages 4-8. Every page has bold, easy-to-color outlines and a fun job to do.

Inside you will find:
  • Lions, elephants, monkeys, frogs, turtles and owls
  • Jungle trees, flowers and sunny scenes
  • Color-by-number pages with an easy color key
  • Mazes, counting, dot-to-dot, matching and spot-the-difference puzzles
  • Word tracing and a word search for early readers
  • Single-sided pages, so markers will not bleed through
Perfect for animal lovers, zoo trips and quiet time.
